svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.9.6.6 Nearness of Doors to Stairs
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.9 MEANS OF EGRESS

g.text: The leading edge of the door, during its
swing, stays 300 mm or more from the riser
SENTENCE (2): AN EXIT DOOR WHERE ICE OR SNOW MAY BLOCK IT
An exit door may open onto one step,
its riser not more than 150 mm

svg.text: The distance between a stair riser and the
leading edge of a door during its swing is not
Except doors serving a single dwelling unit or a
house with a secondary suite, including their
common spaces, and as provided in Sentence (2).
Where there is a danger of blockage from ice
or snow, an exit door, including doors serving
a single dwelling unit, may open onto not more
Provided the riser of that step does not exceed
Drawn: a door onto the top landing of a stair, open at 90 degrees, its swing dashed. White blocks: snow.
